readings.evidence: Native tile [0,1608]: the loop is around x≈790-940, y≈2410-2500. The line continues right across b017. The pencil note is at y≈2470-2560 and is not touched by the line.

readings.source_reading: Pencil arrow '←' in the gutter at the level of c. 375 (1), at y≈2300. At the level of c. 371 (3), at y≈2410, there is a hooked '↵' / '←→' pair: one head points left toward fol. 134b 'n.d:23:7/9:Beng.', and one head '→' points right toward c. 371 (3).
readings.evidence: On fol. 134b, the arrows sit at the ends of the 'ff.350-357…cf. I.C. 2035' line and the 'c.375(4). Do. by Do.…n.d:23:7/9:Beng.' line. The vertical alignment suggests the pairings, but the arrows do not demonstrate which entry each note belongs to.
Two small slanted ink words at x≈400-515, y≈2760-2870, left of the slip edge. The letter forms 'Print' and 'Kira' are plausible, but the endings are cut off by the slip edge or are unclear.
Native tile [1604,1608]: a clear macron stroke is visible over the first 'a' of 'Rāghunātha'.
There is no macron over 'vaca'. A stroke over the letters after 'ṭṭ' reads as a long ā, with dots under 'tt'. The following 'carya' shows no distinct macron.
The first character resembles '1' or 'I', followed by a character like '0' or 'O' and a point. It could be 'I.O.', but this is not determinable, so it is kept literally.
